subject.title: feat(workboard): review gate hard blocks + workboard_submit_review tool

question: Should Workboard add `ready_to_merge` as a durable status and make `workboard_complete` fail closed until a passed review proof exists?
rationale: This changes existing Workboard completion behavior and persisted status shape, so the patch needs maintainer intent beyond mechanical bug repair.

options.title: Repair and keep the new lifecycle
options.body: Preserve the existing result envelope, require passed review proof for every completion path, declare the review tool, update status consumers/tests, and require real behavior proof before merge.

options.title: Redesign without a new durable status
options.body: Keep the review gate concept but express it through existing `review` or proof metadata if maintainers do not want another persisted status.

options.title: Pause the PR
options.body: Leave the production concern open until a maintainer defines the desired Workboard review lifecycle and upgrade behavior.

recommendation.title: Repair and keep the new lifecycle
recommendation.body: Preserve the existing result envelope, require passed review proof for every completion path, declare the review tool, update status consumers/tests, and require real behavior proof before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: Path history shows the broadest ownership of Workboard tool, orchestration, persistence, and manifest decisions affected by this PR.
